2.0.0-alpha.8: Client name suggestions now list every match instead of only three, with a scroll bar when there are many (for example several clients with the same last name).

You can stop a misspelled client name from being suggested: right-click it on the Logs page and choose Stop Suggesting, or hide it in Settings under Client name suggestions. Your log is not changed, Show Again brings a name back, and a hidden name comes back by itself if you export it again.
Fixed: Copy on the Logs page was greyed out. Right-click a file there to copy its file name, its details, the client name, or the whole log line.
Logs: tick the box next to one or more files to export or print only those. Tick All Shown and Clear Selection are at the top.

Date fields now have a calendar button. The calendar has month and year boxes (months are shown as 01 January, 02 February, and so on) to jump straight to a month, and the up and down arrows still step one month at a time. The Logs date filters use the same calendar.

Rename Only: add a file that CleanCutPDF exported earlier and its workspace, client name, and fields are filled back in, so fixing a mistake only takes a quick edit. The Logs page is checked first; otherwise the file name is read using your workspace's filename format. Choose Rename originals in place to fix the file itself.
Reminder: Rename Only never looks for SPLIT HERE sheets, so it is the quickest way to rename a batch of single documents.
2.0.0-alpha.7: Fixed: a client name picked from the suggestions could be left out of the file names. Picking a suggestion with the mouse or with the arrow keys and Enter now always uses the name you see in the box.
Client name suggestions now come from your export log (the Logs page), so any client you have exported before is offered. Folders in the export folder are no longer used.
Fixed: Open Output Folder, Open Folder after an export, and the folder bookmarks opened Documents instead of the right folder.

Fixed: in the Accounting workspace the Revoked switch did nothing when the filename format had no Revoked in it. It is added after the client name once; you can still move or remove it on the Workspaces page.
The Workspaces page now tells you when a field in the workspace is not part of the filename format.
Split & Rename now lists your open PDFs on the left, so you can switch between them without going back to the Inbox.
After you export or close a PDF, the next one in the list opens by itself.
The page list on the left can be collapsed to icons with the new button at its top. Your choice is remembered.
Fixed: a folder bookmark without a color could not be read on the dark theme.
2.0.0-alpha.6: CleanCutPDF now has an installer, and updates install themselves: when a new version is available, choose Install Update and the app downloads it, closes, updates, and reopens. Your open PDFs are saved first.
Every update is checked against its published fingerprint (SHA-256) before it is installed.
New Help page with tips for Split & Rename, Quick Split, Rename Only, printing and scanning SPLIT HERE sheets, and your current keyboard shortcuts.
New tour on first start that walks through each page. Reopen it any time from Help.
The first time CleanCutPDF 2 starts on a computer that has CleanCutPDF 1.x data, it offers to bring that data in.
2.0.0-alpha.5: The Workspace Layout Designer is back: on the Workspaces page, choose Design Layout to drag fields anywhere and resize them, for example two short fields side by side.
The designer opens showing the form as it looks now. Fields you do not move stay exactly as they were, and saving without changing anything leaves the form unchanged.
Snap to Grid keeps fields lined up. You can also move and resize the selected field with the arrow keys.
A field that needs more room (larger text, notes) now moves the fields below it down instead of covering them.
Use Automatic Layout puts a workspace back to the normal stacked form at any time.
Importing from CleanCutPDF 1.x now brings over your custom workspace layouts.
2.0.0-alpha.4: Color themes are back: choose Blue, Green, or Pink in Settings, in light or dark. The change applies instantly.
Choose the font and text size in Settings. Everything in the app, including dialogs, scales with it.
Keyboard shortcuts are back with the same defaults as CleanCutPDF 1.x (Ctrl+O Open PDF, Ctrl+E Export PDFs, Ctrl+F Search Logs, Ctrl+Shift+Z Undo Last Export, and more).
Change any shortcut in Settings: click it and press the new keys. CleanCutPDF warns you if the keys are already in use, and you can reset them all to the defaults.

New Reset Settings button returns settings, workspaces, and custom fields to the defaults after you type a short code. Your license, export history, open PDFs, and shortcuts are kept, and a backup is saved first.
Importing from CleanCutPDF 1.x now also brings over your color theme, font, text size, and keyboard shortcuts.
2.0.0-alpha.3: New Logs page: every exported or renamed file grouped by day and client, with search, workspace and date filters, and sorting. It stays fast with long histories.
Export the history to CSV, TSV, text, or PDF, or print it.
Undo Last Export moves the files from the most recent export to the Recycle Bin, so they can be restored.
Clear Log also moves the old history to the Recycle Bin instead of deleting it.
New 🔍 Zoom button opens the page in a large window: fit to width, Ctrl+scroll to zoom from 50% to 500%.
Save a printable SPLIT HERE sheet from the Inbox or Quick Split page.
Ctrl+Alt+D opens the debug console, which shows everything the app logs as it happens.
Fixed the Workspaces lists and editor resizing while scrolling or typing.
2.0.0-alpha.2: Split & Rename now works end to end: SPLIT HERE pages are found in the background (including colored separator sheets with no text), each Part gets the workspace fields, and Export PDFs saves one file per Part.
All field types are back: text, number, currency, date, dropdown (with Other), checkbox, and toggle, plus autofill, Today buttons, Payment Method → Check Number, notes, and the Aa button.
Exports remove blank pages, can make a client folder, never overwrite files, and record each file in the export history.
The Inbox has folders, multi-select, right-click actions, and Change Workspace / Move to Folder for many PDFs at once.
Open PDFs and everything typed into them are restored when the app starts again.
New Rename Only and Quick Split pages.
Workspace editing is back: create, rename, and delete workspaces, change the filename format with a live preview, choose and order fields, add notes, and create custom fields.
Import your workspaces, fields, settings, open PDFs, folder shortcuts, and export history from CleanCutPDF 1.x (1.x data is only read, never changed).
Folder shortcuts and client-name suggestions are back.
A diagnostic log now records what happened if something goes wrong (Settings › Diagnostics › Logs folder).
Closing the app is now instant and always saves your open PDFs first.
2.0.0-alpha.1: First preview of CleanCutPDF 2, rebuilt in C# with Avalonia for Windows and macOS.
PDF loading and page previews run in the background so the window never freezes.
Previews are cached, prefetched, and cancelled when you move on quickly.
Themes switch instantly without rebuilding the window.
Updates are checked in the background every time the app opens; the license is rechecked weekly. Neither delays startup.
